label: Mollie
description: Connect your Mollie account. Shoppers choose a payment method on Mollie's payment page; turn methods on or off in your Mollie dashboard.

fields.label: API key
fields.description: From your Mollie dashboard: Developers → API keys. Use the test key in your Swell test environment and the live key in live.

fields.label: Payment description
fields.description: Shown to shoppers on Mollie's payment page and their bank statement, for example your store name. Leave empty to use "Order at" and your store's web address. Up to 255 characters.
